data.config.yaml:
apiVersion: operator.config.dynamo.nvidia.com/v1alpha1
kind: OperatorConfiguration
server:
  metrics:
    bindAddress: "0.0.0.0"
    secure: true
  webhook:
    certProvisionMode: "auto"
    secretName: "webhook-server-cert"
    serviceName: heyi-upgrade162-dynamo-operator-webhook-service
leaderElection:
  enabled: true
  id: "dynamo.nvidia.com"
  namespace: "kube-system"
orchestrators:
  kaiScheduler:
    enabled: true
  volcanoScheduler:
    enabled: false
  grove:
    enabled: true
    terminationDelay: "4h"
serviceMesh:
  enabled: false
rbac:
  plannerClusterRoleName: heyi-upgrade162-dynamo-operator-planner
  dgdrProfilingClusterRoleName: heyi-upgrade162-dynamo-operator-dgdr-profiling
  eppClusterRoleName: heyi-upgrade162-dynamo-operator-epp
mpi:
  sshSecretName: "mpi-run-ssh-secret"
  sshSecretNamespace: "heyi-upgrade162"
lpx:
  enabled: false

annotations.kubernetes.io/description: Contains a CA bundle that can be used to verify the kube-apiserver when using internal endpoints such as the internal service IP or kubernetes.default.svc. No other usage is guaranteed across distributions of Kubernetes clusters.
